author: Sunflower State News
title: Senator Roger Marshall honored by NFIB for support of small business tax deduction
text:
Last week, Senator Roger “Doc” Marshall received the Small Business Deduction Champion award from the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB). The recognition was given for his work in ensuring the 20% Small Business Deduction remains permanent. Members are able to display this distinction on a pennant in their Congressional offices.
“Sen. Marshall has consistently stood up for Main Street,” said NFIB State Director Dan Murray. “His leadership was critical in stopping a massive tax hike on small business owners and making the 20% Small Business Deduction permanent. Kansas small business owners are grateful that Sen. Marshall continues to be a strong voice for them in Washington, D.C.”
The award reflects ongoing efforts by lawmakers and organizations like NFIB to advocate for policies that support small businesses at both state and national levels.
